english.note: Use this full form when you want to spell out the term rather than use the common abbreviation 超市.
Use this when the grocery store is specifically a supermarket rather than a street market.

examples.english: The vegetables at this supermarket are very fresh.
examples.traditional: 呢間超級市場啲菜好新鮮。
examples.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 di1 coi3 hou2 san1 sin1

examples.english: I usually buy groceries at the supermarket instead of the market.
examples.traditional: 我平時去超級市場買餸，唔去街市。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 heoi3 ciu1 kap1 si5 coeng4 maai5 sung3 m4 heoi3 gaai1 si5
